channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
80 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Various UI improvements: session modal description scroll works again with overflow clamped, and shop UI sprites remain valid and fully clickable for all tiles.
  • Crash‑site crates (helicopter, Bradley, satellite) now persist across server restarts with a 30 min despawn timer; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons. Hackable crate flags and visuals fixed, and cargo ship event crates now save/load correctly, preventing duplicate spawns.
  • Group tax is displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel; animal trading UI now includes SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels showing nearby sellable animals and expected rewards.

Combat & Damage

  • Radwater now scales damage based on protection instead of flat values, increasing its threat to fully equipped kits.
  • Weapon balance updates: semi‑automatic pistol damage falloff increased and craft cost raised; SMG body spawn chance increased while Rifle body spawn chance decreased.

Comfort & UI

  • Bear rugs provide full comfort within 2 m (falloff to 3 m) and regular rugs within 1 m (falloff to 2 m), fixing previous low solo comfort values.
  • Various UI improvements: session modal description scroll works again with overflow clamped, and shop UI sprites remain valid and fully clickable for all tiles.

Tools & Vehicles

  • Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click, replacing the removed press‑F toggle.
  • Modular car fixes: wheel mirroring corrected and handling refined (reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, smoother steering for high‑speed drifting).
  • HAB armor collider for attack helicopters fixed, ensuring proper removal and collision handling.

AI & Navigation

  • Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships repaired, improving AI pathing.
  • Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps.

Events & Persistence

  • Crash‑site crates (helicopter, Bradley, satellite) now persist across server restarts with a 30 min despawn timer; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons. Hackable crate flags and visuals fixed, and cargo ship event crates now save/load correctly, preventing duplicate spawns.

Economy & Trading

  • Group tax is displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel; animal trading UI now includes SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels showing nearby sellable animals and expected rewards.
  • Store system enhancements: dynamic shop assets restored with UI caching, dynamic references for items, warm‑up tile creation, DynamicPagePrefab added to store takeover, and HealthThresholdToggle introduced for health‑based behavior configuration.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
  • SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
  • Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.
